enchantments.tooltip: Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Quality Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Strength.
Quality Dexterity +3: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Dexterity.
Quality Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Quality bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Reinforced Fists: This item surrounds your fists with kinetic energy. Your unarmed damage is boosted by one and a half die.
Melee Alacrity 15%: Gain 15% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Deception +11: +11 Enhancement bonus to hit and +17 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
